question: What does the angry one destroy?
premises: kruddhaḥ tu saṃharet states when angry he destroys
sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ names all triple world
sa cara acaram includes moving and unmoving
inference: The angry one destroys all triple world, moving and unmoving.
uncertainties: identity of the angry one is not explicit
plain_english: When angry, he destroys all triple world, moving and unmoving.
